key_points: Strongest June quarter ever provides a solid fundamental floor, but much of this may already be priced in given AAPL's recent record highs.
iPhone 18 Pro delivery lead times running below prior-year levels (per JPMorgan) signal softer near-term demand or consumers deferring purchases for the foldable launch.
Mac/iPad price hikes triggered a >6% single-day selloff that some analysts (Gene Munster) call an overreaction, suggesting potential mean-reversion opportunity.
Persistent AI supply chain headwinds and broader AI-slowdown rhetoric from Anthropic/OpenAI leaders create sector-wide sentiment risk over the near term.
Foldable iPhone remains the key forward catalyst but is not yet shipping, limiting its near-term price impact to speculation and pre-orders.
